question:
Four words have been underlined in the given sentence of which one word has a spelling error. Identify the incorrectly spelt word.

The tiger__ thrshed __(A) against his __chains__ (B) in the cage at the __circus__ (C) but nobody paid him any __heed__ (D).
solution:
The correct answer is **'Option 1' i.e. 'thrshed'.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] 

**__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word "**thrshed**" is incorrectly spelled. 
 
• The correct spelling is **"thrashed,**" which means to beat or hit someone or something hard repeatedly.(पीटा).
 
 
• **Example:** The wind thrashed the tree branches against the windows throughout the night.
 
 

Therefore, the **correct answer **is- **thrshed**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• "**Circus**" refers to a traveling company of acrobats, trained animals, and clowns that perform in a tent.(सर्कस).
 
• "**Chains**" refer to a series of linked metal rings used for fastening or securing items, or as a restraint.(जंजीरें).
 
• "**Heed**" means to pay attention to.(ध्यान देना).
